description: CROWD: A global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving provides CROWD metadata for continuous urban dashcam segments, including video identifiers, boundaries and derived detection and tracking labels. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: Version 2 describes worldwide urban localities, with coordinates representing locality centroids, not precise trajectories. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Video rights remain separate. Coordinates are approximate locality centroids, and automatic detections are pseudo-labels, not ground truth. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
